name: Deprecated function usage
description: Flags calls to base-game or project functions marked as deprecated, and recommends supported alternatives where available.
definition: Flags calls to project functions marked `; @deprecated` on the function header or the comment line immediately above it. Base-game functions catalogued in `shared/rules/data/deprecated-functions.yaml` are marked on their bundled saved ASTs at build time, including the configured severity and migration guidance, and follow the same external-signature lookup path. Calls and declarations are resolved case-insensitively. This rule is enabled by the strict and standard presets and disabled by the careful preset.
